notes.title: Price Revision Notice
notes.notes:
Hi, I'm Bunbukuzu, a game creation enthusiast!
I would like to express my gratitude to the many people who have played "Anji-Implication-", which was released on January 28, 2024! 

We are pleased to announce a permanent price revision of the "Anji-Implication-"

The price has been changed from [b]$5.00 before the revision to $2.99[/b].


For those who have not yet played "Anji-Implication-" or have recently become aware of Bunbukuzu activities
We would be very happy if you could play "Anji-Implication-", Bunbukuzu first horror work.

We look forward to your continued support of Bunbukuzu!
